# A second USD bill posting to the same USD expense account as the first,
# applying the first bill's posting transaction as its payment.
#
# The first bill's posting holds an expense split and a payable split. The
# payable split is in the first bill's lot, so the split left for `txn_guid:`
# to find is the expense one — and this bill posts to that same account, so
# every test the linking branch makes passes it.
#
# Nothing here is a payment. A posting transaction records what a bill owes,
# and that is as true of another bill's posting as of this bill's own.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal, with the first bill's posting
# untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-SELF-002"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-03-13
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-13
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-13
    due: 2026-04-13
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-SELF-002"
    accumulate: true
  payment: none
